title: Air Force censorship of Pan-STARRS imagery

tellings.quote: A much smaller all sky survey called Pan Stars, the same one which discovered AmuA Mua, underwent massive censorship from the Air Force

plain: The US Air Force is said to have heavily censored images from Pan-STARRS, a sky survey telescope that scans the whole sky and that found the strange interstellar object called 'Oumuamua. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, as an example of the military controlling what astronomers are allowed to see and share.
